description: Shared push token v1 test vector. The shape of an APNs token that the plugin's Live Activity registrations (plugin/src/delivery/registrations.js, mirrored into the Host Helper) and the Push Relay (relay/src/worker.js, for alerts and Live Activities) both accept: 16 to 1024 lowercase hex characters. Each case is `unit` repeated `count` times. `accepted` holds the two bounds and the lengths APNs has issued (64, 160 for a device token, 256 for a Live Activity on an iOS 27 Simulator); `rejected` holds what stays out. A change here changes both patterns together.
